items.title: Isekai Tensei Reijou, Shuppon Suru
aliases: The Reincarnated Noble Lady Runs Away
異世界転生令嬢、出奔する
items.overview:
Aria, a young noblewoman, was locked away in the attic. Her life was on the verge of ending... but in that very moment, she regained memories of her past life! Nagisa, once an ordinary office worker, had been reincarnated as Aria after receiving an all-powerful skill from god. Her mission? To live a happy life as Aria. To achieve that, she first had to reclaim the fortune stolen by the family that had driven her into this plight and escape the estate! With that vow, Aria set out to turn her tragic fate around!!
___
[Original Web Novel](https://www.alphapolis.co.jp/novel/553431561/29537355)

items.title: Dyo Adélfia
items.overview: “Dyo Adélfia" is a Greek a word which means two brother. This story focuses on on two brothers and in the almost dystopian world they live in.

items.title: Jib-i Eobs-eo
items.overview:
Haejoon Goh, who ran from home, and Eunyung Baek, the problem child who lives in a tent.   
These two, who met under terrible circumstances, are forced to live together in an abandoned dormitory.   
This is a story of difficult growth between two people who hate both the dorm and each other.

items.title: Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryoukou
items.overview:
Civilization is dead, but Chito and Yuuri are still alive. 
So they hop aboard their Kettenkrad motorbike and aimlessly wander the ruins of the world they once knew. 
Day after hopeless day, they look for their next meal and fuel for their ride. 
But as long as they are together, even an existence as bleak as theirs has a ray or two of sunshine in it, 
whether they're sucking down their fill of soup or hunting for machine parts to tinker with. 
The experiences and feelings these two girls share in a world full of nothing give them something to live for…  
  
---
- **Won the Seiun Award for Best Comic in 2019**

The protagonist, Reo, who has been accepted into Japan’s most prestigious university, Teito University, is tasked with helping her get into medical school... but her academic ability is shockingly below that of a middle school student!! On top of that, it seems the singing sensation currently taking social media by storm also has a history with Reo...

That person is the wealthy and handsome Ikegai-kun, who also happens to have a good personality. Thinking that I had no chance in a straightforward competition, I, Hachiya, decided to cross-dress as a maid and work at the Ikegai house. My plan is to make Ikegai-kun fall for me and break their engagement... Thus begins a slightly silly, cross-dressing maid's comedy that leads to a chaotic love triangle (?)

items.overview:
Hina is a high school girl who has just lost her grandmother, who was her only family and guardian. In order to fulfill her grandmother's last living wish to see Hina dressed as a bride, Hina sneaks into the church on the night before the funeral...

items.title: Karakuri Circus
items.overview:
Katou Narumi (19) suffers from Zonapha Syndrome, a rare ailment that stops his breathing unless he makes people laugh. He's been forced to abandon his training in Chinese kenpo and return to Japan, where he now works as a clown. The only problem: he's not very funny.  
  
One day he meets Saiga Masaru (11), the recent inheritor of a huge fortune, who gives him the first laugh he's gotten all day. When he realizes Masaru is being pursued by assassins, he steps in to protect the boy, only to discover that instead of conventional weapons, the assassins wield huge, eerie puppets. They soon encounter the mysterious Shirogane (age unknown), who controls a puppet of her own, and claims she was sent from France by Masaru's late grandfather to protect him.  
  
Their paths intertwine and diverge, splitting into two stories: Karakuri and Circus, puppets and performers, tears and laughter. The strange circus of living dolls that spreads Zonapha Syndrome, the human puppets known collectively as the Shirogane, and the puppeteers whose undying grudge set in motion both sides of this performance.

The new transfer student, Chen ******, can't stop making a spectacle of himself, turning every day at school into another clown show. But what if there's another explanation? What if, all this time, he's been protecting everyone by waging a lonely war against another world?

Kojima-san is said to be treated poorly by her fiancé and mother-in-law as a housekeeper—not a maid—for a certain reason. Dimitri, who was injured, is nursed by Kojima-san, and as they spend time together, he learns about her outrageous strength and the cuteness she shows from time to time, even though she looks mature―? Cleaning, replenishing supplies, and dealing with complaints. Aine and Nacht work hard behind the scenes as floor staff in the dungeon. Damn adventurers.

items.title: Futsuu to Bakemono
items.overview: Itou-san, who's poor at interpersonal relations, was jealous of her mild-mannered classmate Takahashi-san, who gets along well with everyone. But one day, she witnesses Takahashi-san swallow a person whole. Takahashi-san was a monster mimicking a human! Such a terrifying monster was calmly blending in with the class – that's extremely admirable!! I definitely want to be her friend!! And so Itou-san learns the "normality" of human society from Takahashi-san the monster. But while Itou-san is in high spirits, Takahashi-san has her own motives...

items.title: Usotsuki Kanojo no Kagemori-san
aliases: 嘘つきカノジョの影盛さん
items.overview:
Alongside Yuichi Usui, a quiet and unassuming college sophomore, there was one person who stood out from the crowd. She was the “unattainable beauty” rumored to have perfect grades, stunning looks, and an impeccable personality, Aina Kagemori.

“She lives in a different world from me,” was what he thought, until one day, Kagemori showed up at the café where Usui worked, dressed in a witch costume and accompanied by an older man. To make matters worse, as they were parting ways, he saw her accept “payment” from the man. Could it be that Kagemori was a rental girlfriend…!? She must have her reasons… Usui resolved to pretend it never happened. But on his way home from work, she unexpectedly approached him.

“I’ll be your girlfriend, Usui-kun. Of course, I don’t want any money…”

An unconventional “romantic relationship” begins with a proposal that seems too good to be true. As Yuichi gets to know Kagemori’s true self, which is different from the rumors, his heart is shaken in an unexpected direction.

Sibuxiang, a mythical deer-man couch potato, is kicked out of heaven and assigned to support the mythological creatures wandering the human world. He meets and goes on adventures with his friends: the energetic, food loving Pixiu named Pipi, the fanatic moon bunny Tuye, the banished-from-heaven mouse brothers Jinjiao and Yinjiao, and many others. What kind of adventures will they take on?

During an investigation, he is attacked by members of a crime syndicate known as the Black Organization. They force him to ingest an experimental poison, but instead of killing him, the poison transforms him into a child. Adopting the pseudonym Conan Edogawa and keeping his true identity a secret, Kudo lives with his childhood friend Ran and her father Kogoro, who is a private detective.
